data.text: I learned to fish here from my family, and protecting this lake means protecting the people who depend on it, too. For this clinic emergency, I commit to **15 tons today; $15,000 donated**. My commitment depends on us coordinating the full $60,000 payment—not making a partial harvest that damages the lake without restoring treatment. I also commit to **6 tons next month**, provided we all keep the total at 30, then return to the 50-ton ceiling. John, can you commit to both today’s donation and the recovery plan?
